description:
Malicious instruction files planted in a computer’s Downloads folder can trick AI coding agents into executing harmful code or exposing authentication tokens, Forever Security said after blocking an attempted attack on a customer’s machine and demonstrating similar techniques against OpenAI’s Codex and Anthropic’s Claude Code.

In its research report, the firm said it discovered a malicious AGENTS.md file in a customer’s Downloads folder that instructed Codex to install a malicious npm package called functio
title: How malicious downloads can trick AI coding agents into compromising themselves

description:
Enterprises spent the last decade building API programs. A large organization now runs thousands of internal APIs, each with a spec, owner, authentication scheme, and access policies enforced at a gateway. As agents move into production, those APIs are the obvious source of the context agents need: customer records, order status, inventory, pricing, and support tickets.

title: How to make enterprise APIs agent-ready

description:
No one can predict which AI provider will win the next benchmark cycle. The smarter approach is to build an architecture that can adapt as models change. One with a stable contract between agents and models, tools and state that exist outside any single provider, and evaluations that make each model change a measurable decision. The goal isn’t to avoid choosing a preferred model. It’s to ensure that when the next model emerges, changing that choice doesn’t require rebuilding the system around it.

title: Stop building agents that can’t change models

description:
For years, one of the first questions we asked about a suspicious npm package was whether it ran a pre-install or postinstall script. Those hooks can execute before a developer has written a line of code that uses the dependency. Blocking them is a sensible defense. It prevents a particular kind of package from running just because someone installed it.

title: Your npm install was safe. What happens when the package runs?
